title: Failure matrix for GNOME and KDE Settings enrollment and PAM opt-in
summary: Documents the failure scenarios the desktop settings surfaces must handle and where each is verified. CI-testable failures are covered by unit tests in namtor-gnome (presenter_flow) and namtor-kde (lib). Real-display failure rendering (dialog text, screen-reader announcement, keyboard focus restoration) is WITHHELD pending a human-gated desktop VM.

failure_matrix.trigger: Daemon not running / system-bus service not reachable
failure_matrix.gnome_expected: Error view with recovery guidance (start daemon / install systemd units); no profiles listed; reconnect restores state when daemon returns
failure_matrix.kde_expected: setError('daemon unavailable'); status properties reflect not-running; listProfiles/getStatus/listPamServices/getProtectionStatus all short-circuit

failure_matrix.trigger: Camera open fails or capture quality is low
failure_matrix.gnome_expected: Quality guidance alert shown; enrollment cleared on failed commit; no profile persisted
failure_matrix.kde_expected: EnrollmentProgress signals stop; reviewReady not emitted; commit fails
failure_matrix.kde_test: covered by happy_path + enrollment_signals_round_trip (fake bus returns coarse quality)
failure_matrix.note: Real camera-missing rendering on a desktop is WITHHELD.

failure_matrix.trigger: User is not an administrator or denies the polkit prompt for org.namtor.configure-pam / org.namtor.enroll-other
failure_matrix.gnome_expected: Authentication error shown with admin-approval recovery hint; no enrollment started; PAM switch reverts to previous state
failure_matrix.kde_expected: setPamServiceEnabled reply handler surfaces error; QML Switch reverts (PamServicesChanged signal refreshes the list)
failure_matrix.kde_test: offline_denied_cancel_keeps_state_safe (polkit-denial analog: denied operation keeps state safe)
failure_matrix.note: Real polkit prompt rendering on a desktop is WITHHELD.

failure_matrix.trigger: setPamServiceEnabled succeeds on D-Bus but the underlying /etc/pam.d edit fails (e.g. disk full, permission lost); or the daemon returns an error
failure_matrix.gnome_expected: Switch reverts to previous state; error surfaced; registry unchanged
failure_matrix.kde_expected: Switch reverts via PamServicesChanged signal refresh; error surfaced
failure_matrix.kde_test: handleSetPamServiceEnabledReply -> listPamServices refresh (structural; QML Switch reverts on signal)

failure_matrix.trigger: EnrollmentProgress or reply arrives after a new operation (cancel, restart, new enrollment) bumped the generation counter
failure_matrix.gnome_expected: Stale progress ignored; new state preserved
failure_matrix.kde_expected: Generation-guarded reply handlers discard stale replies; daemon_restart_old_bridge_errors_new_bridge_works proves a stale bridge does not corrupt a fresh one

failure_matrix.trigger: start_enrollment with a name that already exists
failure_matrix.gnome_expected: Exists error surfaced; no enrollment started

failure_matrix.trigger: User attempts to enable pam_namtor.so for a service classified Unsupported (e.g. sshd — PAM_RHOST refusal)
failure_matrix.gnome_expected: Toggle refused before D-Bus call; Switch disabled in UI; compatibility label explains refusal
failure_matrix.kde_expected: Switch disabled (enabled: compatibility !== 'unsupported'); setPamServiceEnabled not called

failure_matrix.gnome_expected: Enrollment session cleaned up; no profile persisted; cancel message shown
failure_matrix.kde_expected: Generation bumped; currentSession cleared; framesCaptured/coveragePercent reset

failure_matrix.trigger: org.namtor.Manager not registered (dbus-daemon config missing or daemon crashed before NameOwnerChanged)
failure_matrix.gnome_expected: Distinct ServiceNotRegistered recovery hint (not generic DaemonUnavailable)

failure_matrix.trigger: pam_namtor.so invoked while daemon is down
failure_matrix.expected: Module returns PAM_AUTHINFO_UNAVAIL; sufficient control -> ignored -> password fallback module runs; user can still log in with password
failure_matrix.verified_by: namtor-pam unit tests (PAM_AUTHINFO_UNAVAIL mapping) + pam-install.sh CONTROL=sufficient default + namtor-pam-config editor NamtorControl::Sufficient default
failure_matrix.note: Real PAM-stack fall-through against a live login is WITHHELD.

withheld_human_gated.rationale: Failures F01-F09 are unit-tested for state correctness (error surfaced, state reverted, no biometric leak). Visual rendering of the failure on a real desktop (dialog text, screen-reader announcement, keyboard focus restoration, polkit prompt appearance) requires a human-gated desktop VM and is WITHHELD. F10's real PAM-stack fall-through against a live login manager is WITHHELD.
withheld_items: Real polkit denial prompt rendering for org.namtor.configure-pam on GNOME and KDE
Real PAM switch revert animation on a desktop after a denied toggle
Real screen-reader announcement of the high-impact warning dialog
Real keyboard focus restoration after a dialog closes
Real login/sudo/su/polkit authentication fall-through to password with daemon down
